submissions.title: Data center not permitted under zoning of former Hynix factory, city says
submissions.excerpt: the City Council could not have intended the 'Information Technology Services' use to encompass the large modern data centers
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION: City of Eugene, OR planning director Alissa Hunter ruled that a data center is not an allowed use under the E-1 'Campus Employment' zoning at the former Hyundai/Hynix plant (1830 Willow Creek Circle), rejecting a zone-verification request filed on behalf of an undisclosed prospective buyer. Blocks a proposed (unannounced-client) data center at that site; the ruling can be appealed to the Oregon Land Use Board of Appeals. submissions.title: Fort Wayne city councilwoman introduces ordinances to rein in future data center development
submissions.excerpt: a 365-day moratorium on city actions that could support future data center development
submissions.note: SITING RESTRICTION (PROPOSED, NOT YET ENACTED): Fort Wayne, IN councilwoman Rohli Booker introduced two ordinances on Sept 9, 2026: a 365-day moratorium on Council/city actions (rezonings, annexations, tax abatements, contracts) that would support new data center development, plus a 9-member advisory commission to study resource-intensive developments; report due back within a year. Council has not yet voted as of this writing. The existing, already-operating Google Fort Wayne Data Center is explicitly carved out and unaffected. No tracked project record needs updating from this alone; flagging as a restriction-in-progress worth watching for a future vote.
